report:
Fresh delta-based review of meta.book.browser_delivery. Preserved and read the prior input/output, started fresh and recaptured all three prior additional fragments. Comparison of every fragment by path/selector shows exactly one change: four prerequisite-comment lines in the unrelated canonical-source TODO within the whole spec_plan.rs capture, documenting envelope-clause prose/source-span/owner prerequisites. No fragment was added or removed after recapture; implementation/test metadata, the complete browser_delivery claim, its own TODO and all three ordinary tests/helpers are unchanged. That comment does not affect this claim's behavior or adequacy. The full assessment was reconsidered and follows; no edits, build or tests performed.

Requirements: book generation, standalone export and local serving must share the resolved model/renderer; invalid inputs must diagnose before partial publication; artifacts must bundle navigation/search/entity/Rust-source data and assets for server-free use; each view must identify a snapshot; rebuild/export/restart must expose model and Rust changes. The sole implementation association is the explicit TODO browser_delivery_modes_share_a_validated_snapshot in spec_plan.rs, also the fourth associated test. Its comment calls for cross-mode comparison, invalid-model rejection, offline use and regeneration. It is a pending implementation/test entry, not ordinary implementation evidence. There is no ordinary implementation association to certify as fulfilling the full delivery contract.

Partial ordinary evidence, reassessed in full: book_asset_is_self_contained_and_embeds_exact_script_safe_model_and_source creates real model/Rust files containing hostile script-shaped text, preprocesses, checks no external script/stylesheet or unresolved template placeholders, parses embedded JSON and asserts exact prose/Rust contents, a Rust target mapping and nested-crate navigation paths. This supports static bundling and script-safe embedded content for book output; it does not execute offline navigation/search or establish export/serve equivalence. invalid_models_and_correspondence_fail_before_publishing_an_explorer exercises unknown types, missing correspondence and wrong-crate correspondence, requiring failed exit, the specific diagnostic, empty stdout and no explorer asset. This establishes the tested book failure-before-publication cases. unchanged_preprocessing_preserves_asset_timestamp_and_source_edits_refresh_it checks byte/mtime preservation for unchanged preprocessing, edits .sage prose and requires updated artifact and chapter contents. Its edit is model prose, not Rust; Rust refresh and other delivery modes remain deferred. Captured Fixture helpers invoke the real preprocess executable and parse actual artifacts; these assertions are substantive, not test-name evidence.

Deferral and prerequisites: shared resolved-renderer behavior across all three modes, actual offline interactive operations, snapshot labeling of every view and complete model/Rust regeneration across rebuild/export/restart remain explicit TODO scope. Completing the placeholder requires real cross-mode integration/browser fixtures and implementation associations, including Rust-edit refresh, not treating static book assertions or a passing empty TODO as full coverage. There are no N/A entries. The unrelated prerequisite comment does not close or expand this claim's delivery TODO. No new concrete defect or requested edit; no test execution outcome claimed.
